title: docs(pm-dispatch): an epic's next milestone is carded only on the maintainer's go

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDXnu6Ug6Y7hBQPeooxGQYF)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：专题（epic）不再自动滚动拆下一个里程碑。当前里程碑子卡全关后，负责车道或专题席在父单贴拆分小结（下一里程碑的卡、车道、依赖边、各自代价），您答 go 才立新子卡；所有专题一律如此，不再分"高风险"。
- 为什么改：您的裁决「不应该自动拆」，每一波新卡先给您看再拆（「31763 比如这个，我现在不着急开发」）。
- 风险与回滚：只改两份 pm-dispatch 内部规则文本，无门禁、无脚本、无产品代码；两文件行数净零。回滚即还原本 PR。分诊每日看板与轮次记录多一项「待维护者」读数，不拦任何东西。
- 先看：`references/seat-lifecycle.md`〈Epic 子树车道〉的滚动拆卡两行与暂停行；`references/triage-duties.md` 新读数行与追踪父单结卡行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`，预期两文件 headroom 0、id-lint 全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（`.claude/**` 走席位契约复审）。若不同意"下一里程碑的卡只在 go 后才立"这一读法，审阅时指出即可。

Fixes #32419

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none (internal pm-dispatch rules text; nothing under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` teaches the rolling split)

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈Epic 子树车道〉:

- The rolling-split line 「滚动拆卡:只当前与下一个里程碑是卡,余为表行;高风险专题拆前贴小结,维护者裁 go/no-go。」 becomes two lines: only the current milestone is cards, the rest are table rows; when its children are all closed, the owning lane or epic seat posts a split summary on the parent (the next milestone's cards, lanes, edges and cost); no new child until the maintainer answers go; with no go the epic waits, which is not a stall. The "high-risk" qualifier is gone, so it binds every epic.
- The pause line holds every not-started child (was: those of the current and next milestone).
- The line that folded later-milestone children into the table and closed them `not_planned` on a pause is cut: under the line above no later-milestone child exists. A legacy epic that filed its next milestone ahead under the old wording now has those cards held by the pause line instead of closed (a card's fate stays with the maintainer).

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`:

- New reading: the daily dashboard and the round record list, under 「待维护者」 (awaiting the maintainer), each epic whose current milestone is done, with its split summary posted or not. A reading, not a gate (「新增门禁默认否」).
- A tracking parent closes `completed` only when its sub-issues **and its table rows** are all done. Without this, triage's existing close rule would close an epic waiting for a go as finished, since all its filed children are closed.
- Paid by cutting 「轮次记录分写「决策卡 N」与「待您审合 PR M」,不合计;后者 = open `pm:awaiting-merge` PR。」, a restatement: `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈轮次报告与节奏〉 (read by every seat each fire) carries 「决策箱:决策卡 N·待您审合 PR M」 and 「两数 ⛔ 不合计」, and `SKILL.md` defines `pm:awaiting-merge`.

### The seat's call on the card's open point

The card leaves to the skills lane "whether next-milestone cards may still be filed ahead of time … or only on the go". The seat's reading: **only on the go**. The ruling is that nothing is split before the maintainer sees it, and filing next-milestone cards ahead of the go is a split. So 「只当前与下一个里程碑是卡」 becomes "only the current milestone is cards; the next is a table row until the go". The maintainer can overturn this at review.

### Every place that teaches the rolling split (grep on `origin/main` f0f729e7)

`git grep -n -E '滚动拆|拆卡|里程碑|go/no-go|高风险专题' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch .claude/agents/os-dev.md`

| Hit | Action |
|:---|:---|
| `seat-lifecycle.md` rolling-split line | amended (two lines) |
| `seat-lifecycle.md` pause line (current and next milestone) | amended |
| `seat-lifecycle.md` later-milestone children closed on pause | cut, see above |
| `seat-lifecycle.md` milestone table / epic definition lines | still true, unchanged |
| `seat-post-protocol.md` old-style epic migration line | still true, unchanged |
| `SKILL.md` `epic:#n` row and the references table row, both pointing at 〈Epic 子树车道〉 | still true, unchanged |
| `SKILL.md` `pm:retriage` row (拆卡 as a question to triage) | unrelated, unchanged |
| `os-dev.md`, `references/lanes/**` | no hit |

Measured against the order: `triage-duties.md` on f0f729e7 has no daily epic sweep (its epic lines are routing, tracking parents and the parent close rule). The reading is added beside the round-record lines, and the parent close rule is the region amended.
